no_equivalent.pct_18_24: Data Profile groups 15-19 and 20-24; no 18-24 row. Cells checked by label (B01001) and by value (share spot-check).
no_equivalent.pct_45_64: Data Profile has 45-54, 55-59, 60-64 with rounding on each; checked by label and value instead.
no_equivalent.pct_under_18: 2006-2010 Data Profile has no 'Under 18' percent row (2016-2020 is checked).
no_equivalent.pct_family_households: 2016-2020 Data Profile replaced 'Family households' with married/cohabiting/no-spouse types (2006-2010 is checked).
no_equivalent.pct_below_200pct_poverty: Not in the Data Profile; C17002 cells checked by label and value.
no_equivalent.pct_walk_bike: Data Profile folds bicycle into 'Other means'; checked by label and value.
no_equivalent.pct_limited_english: Data Profile counts people who speak English less than very well, not limited-English households; checked by label and value.
no_equivalent.pct_no_internet: Not in the Data Profile; B28002 checked by label and value.
no_equivalent.mean_gross_rent: Census publishes no mean rent; aggregate rent (B25065) and cash renters (B25063_002) are each checked against data.census.gov.
no_equivalent.mean_home_value: Census publishes no mean value; computed from B25075 bin midpoints (a modeling choice, documented). Bins are checked against the table shells.

traps.what: Same label as the 65+ percent ('Percent!!SEX AND AGE!!Total population!!65 years and over') but it is the heading row of the 65+ sex breakdown; Census fills its percent column with the count. Caught by this gate on 2026-11-17 (STRATA 10.3% vs '15564').

pct_under_18.2011-2015: The 2011-2015 Data Profile has no 'Under 18 years' percent row.

pct_family_households.2015-2019: From 2019 the Data Profile replaced 'Family households' with married-couple / cohabiting / no-spouse types.

pct_foreign_born.2020-2024: No 'Foreign born' percent row under PLACE OF BIRTH in the 2024 Data Profile labels.
